draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 68th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 183, well after his grade rank (68th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Ronnie Harrison. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 62 tackles in 2022, 14th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Denver Broncos. 33 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2024. Weak spots: season snap share 3.0% (7th percentile), passes defended 0 (8th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 3.0% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, below the norm.
